claims.statement: Charles VIII of France crosses the Alps, enters Florence and Naples, and then retreats. Italy becomes a battlefield of the French and Spanish crowns for decades.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Standard chronologies of the period.
